paragraphs: Naḥman: R. Yehoshua bar Naḥman; R. Yitzḥak bar Naḥman; R. Yishmael bar Naḥman; Rav Pappa bar Naḥman; R. Shemuel bar Naḥman. [Glosses: Naḥman. (a) Kiddushin 6b: Rav Naḥman spoke to Rav Ashi—a scribal error, for the matter in Gittin 85b has Rav Ḥanan speak to Rav Ashi. (b) Ḥullin 95b: Rav Naḥman of Nehardea should read Rav Ḥanan; not corrected. (c) Makkot 21a: Rav Naḥman son of Rav Ika should read Rav Ḥinena; not corrected. (d) Asheri, Elu Terefot: 'Did Rav Naḥman say thus? But Rav Naḥman bar Minyomi said' is a scribal error; it should read Rav Yosef bar Minyomi.]
